'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jesse Reynolds LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jesse Reynolds]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jesse Reynolds]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan (V) / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)|We Have A Plan]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
